# v2.0.0 Implementation Verification

## Scope and Status

The [agreed scope](v2.0.0-scope.md) was implemented and verified on `codex/feat/v2-context-optimization`, based on v1.1.0. This record is upstream maintainer evidence, not an additional workflow for template adopters. No commit, tag, push, or release was created as part of implementation.

The AppRelay source material was adapted rather than copied: `.github/copilot-instructions.md` remains the canonical global source introduced in v1.1.0. `AGENTS.md` remains a thin reference, and `CLAUDE.md` retains the native shared-file import.

## Delivered

- Task-dependent routing replaces blanket handbook/overview loading in the default instructions.
- One primary owner, focused role profiles with YAML selection metadata, and minimal Claude/Codex adapters.
- Compact optional diagnostics, retaining the off default and chat/task override semantics.
- [Rationale and guide](../../howto/context-optimization.md), [migration prompt](../../howto/prompts/context-optimization.md), and [v1 upgrade path](../../howto/upgrades/v1-to-v2.md).
- README, delivery handbook, and bootstrap walkthrough links aligned with the default workflow.

## Static Checks

- `git diff --check`: passed.
- YAML parsed for all seven shared role profiles and seven Claude adapters; names, descriptions, and role references checked.
- TOML parsed for all seven Codex adapters; registration metadata is unchanged and each instruction body contains its role reference only.
- Changed/new Markdown link targets, heading anchors, and code fences checked.
- Claude import target exists; shared precedence and diagnostic rules have one canonical source.
- No files under `docs/project/`, `docs/specs/`, `docs/tasks/`, or `docs/quality/` were changed by this migration.

These checks validate structure and rule text. They do not demonstrate that every model obeys the rules.

## Scenario Walkthroughs

| Scenario | Structural review and result |
| --- | --- |
| Small read-only question | Entry and shared rules route to one role and affected sources; no blanket overview or handbook requirement remains. |
| Fresh bootstrap | Disposable v2 copy retains steps 0–12 in order, completion/deferral gates, linked questions, baselines, and acceptance checks; no separate optimization prompt is required. |
| Spec/task with a blocking question | Shared rules still require reading linked questions and recording resolution or explicit deferral before dependent task creation or implementation. This was reviewed statically, not exercised in an authenticated model session. |
| Existing v1 project | A disposable selective-merge fixture retained a custom `knowledge/` documentation root, production-approval rule, completed overview/task, `TASK-010-007`, and diagnostic default `on`. Protected documents remained byte-for-byte unchanged. This simulates the documented merge strategy; no automatic migration tool is supplied or claimed. |
| Diagnostics | Rule review retains default off, chat on/off, task-only restoration, and no automatic file changes. Compact output reports only sources actually read. Live persistence/output remains deferred. |
| Authorization | Existing approval and deployment constraints remain binding; routing does not authorize commits, publication, destructive actions, or security bypasses. |

## Context Measurement

Word counts are approximate file-text measurements, not tokenizer counts or guarantees about runtime context usage.

| Measurement | v1.1.0 | Prepared v2 | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Same 25 entry/shared/handbook/role/adapter files | 5,977 words | 4,553 words | About 24% smaller |
| Representative Technical Lead read-only start: entry, shared source, role index, one role; v1 also required handbook and overview | 4,186 words | 1,511 words | About 64% smaller |

The new how-to and upgrade guides are intentionally outside universal startup context and are not included in the 25-file comparison. Task-specific sources and host-injected instructions can increase actual context. No fixed 32K-capacity claim is made.

## Deferred Runtime Verification

Claude model behavior could not be live-tested because no authenticated subscription was available; Copilot CLI was not installed. The project owner accepted the lack of live verification. Native format documentation was consulted for YAML metadata and Claude imports; actual client loading, diagnostics persistence, and model compliance remain unverified. Recheck those in the target tool before making a live-compatibility claim.

The project owner subsequently authorized committing, pushing, and publishing v2.0.0 with these limitations. The release process verifies the final source commit, tag, and release notes before publication.
